about: The side plane (d2, d3) of the SAS triangle grid of the DES Y3 Map3 rows: 20 logarithmic side bins from 0.5 to 80 arcmin, the 9 x 9 block kept by the 8 arcmin lower-edge cut (each pair with 63 opening-angle bins), and the four aperture radii.  Written by the export cell of aperture_mass_statistic.ipynb, Section 5, from the likelihood/joint_shear.yaml keys.
